# Lenis

Lenis 1.3.27, MIT copyright darkroom.engineering. See LENIS-LICENSE.txt.

Source: the same pinned distribution used in Prince's portfolio, originally from https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis . The source-map reference and a redundant self-assignment to the class prototype were removed so the distribution can be imported as a strict ES module. The scrolling implementation is unchanged.

This local file enables the portfolio's desktop wheel feel without a CDN or package installation. Touch, reduced-motion, nested tables and form controls retain native scrolling.
